product_js.description:
Transform your bedroom with this beautifully designed Christian Comforter Set, featuring inspiring Bible verses and accents. It’s the perfect meaningful gift for the women in your life, ideal for birthdays, special occasions, or as a constant reminder of faith and love from Jeminise.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: An inspirational Christian bedding set featuring Bible verses and accents, perfect for Mom, Daughter, Sister, or as a religious gift.
  • Product Type Options: Available as a Comforter for all-in-one warmth and convenience, or a Duvet Cover (no filling insert) for a lightweight, customizable option.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: Each package includes 1 Duvet Cover or Comforter and optional Pillowcases.
  • Material Details: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric, offering a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel. Comforters include whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable; wash separately in cold water and air dry without heat. Microfiber dries quickly and becomes fluffier; recommended to wash in a mesh laundry bag.

Material Polyester
Pattern Letter Print
